name: marketpane-mobile
description: MarketPane - Android app for the MarketPane trading-education platform. A single WebView loads the same web/ build used on desktop, backed by a tiny native HTTP server (see android/app/src/main/java/.../MarketPaneHttpServer.kt) that serves it and forwards /api/* requests to the JS dispatch bridge in src/bridge/ - no embedded Node.js runtime, full feature parity with desktop.
